recipe.visualDefinition: A circular sepia-toned photographic portrait of a couple in vintage attire, encased within a heavily embossed, ornate gold frame that features intricate floral filigree and 3D script lettering integrated into the metallic texture.
coreVisualRelationships: Circular central image framed by an square gold border
High-contrast metallic gold versus muted sepia photography
Textured gold surface interacting with smooth photographic gradients
Script typography following the arc of the circular frame
coreInvariants: 3D beveled gold texture on all graphic elements
Ornate acanthus leaf filigree in corners

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A couple is centered within a circular window, occupying approximately 50% of the total canvas area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The circular frame acts as the primary anchor, separating the textured gold background from the smooth photo.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top script, follow the circular frame down to the bottom signature, then settle on the central couple.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The gold background serves as textured negative space, providing a heavy, luxurious weight to the perimeter.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep shadows and bright specular highlights on the gold
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation throughout; value contrast is high between the dark photo center and the bright gold highlights.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Cursive script with high-ascenders and flourished terminals
letterConstructionRules: Letters must appear as 3D extruded gold
Connected script with varying stroke thickness
Arched baseline for the top text
Sharp, beveled edges to catch light
characterSpecificRedesigns: Terminals taper into fine points like filigree

composition.position: Top center, following the curve of the frame

treatment.shadow: Drop shadow on the gold background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Matching script styles for top and bottom text to maintain a unified 18th-century aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the formal, flourished cursive skeleton
Necessary to achieve the metallic extrusion effect

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square gold textured background with a central circular cutout. Inside the circle, place a sepia-toned vintage photo of a couple near a classic car. Surround the circle with an ornate, 3D gold baroque frame with floral filigree in the corners.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply 3D beveled gold script lettering. The main title should arch over the top of the circular frame, and a smaller signature script should be centered at the bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the text rendered as a 3D gold object?
Is the central photo strictly sepia-toned?
Does the frame feature intricate baroque floral patterns?

mustAchieve: Seamless integration of text and frame

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the gold has specular highlights and deep shadows.
Check that the script follows the circular path accurately.
Verify the sepia photo has a subtle 'cracked' texture.
Confirm the filigree is symmetrical across the vertical axis.
recipe.reuseFormula: Ornate Gold Tondo + Sepia Vintage Portrait + 3D Beveled Script
